operations.title: Prime and gamma traces do not separately define positive xi Weyl measures
operations.statement: For x=y^2 with y>1/2, R_Xi is exactly the completed logarithmic derivative divided by 2y and decomposes into pole, digamma, and a negative von-Mangoldt prime-power trace. Individual pole and zeta singularities cancel only after completion. Hence the desired positive Stieltjes measure is not a termwise positive pushforward of primes or gamma modes; positivity can emerge only from the globally continued completed combination.
operations.scope: Exact Euler-half-plane decomposition and no-go for termwise positive prime pushforward; does not falsify the completed Stieltjes property.

operations.title: Euler–gamma Weyl-measure sign and pole-cancellation test
operations.description: Differentiate the completed Euler product in Re(s)>1, track the von Mangoldt sign, and audit the cancelling pole singularities before Stieltjes continuation.
